comment: Fast, self-contained, deterministic, READ-ONLY reproduce commands only.
024 -- needs four adapters captured first, and libical does not build here.
046 -- runs the Perl adapter; killed at a 400s deadline, and its timeout
column is a property of the machine by its own admission.
087 -- --run <adapter>; a full scoring pass, ~3 min per adapter.
088 -- its only adapter-free mode is --reference, which WRITES a tracked
data file. A drift check must not have side effects. Staleness there
is covered instead by the __cases_id__ stamp those references now
carry (finding 092), which makes a stale reference exit non-zero.
091 -- scans findings/, so its output changes whenever a finding is added.
Its guard is its own non-zero exit on a stale or unsupported provenance declaration (finding 093), wired into the suite as tests/test_figure_provenance.py -- not a baseline.
